in_english.name: Nazmi
in_english.meaning: organized, systematic, one who maintains order
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nazmi originates from Arabic roots, specifically from the word 'nazm', meaning 'order' or 'arrangement'. In Islamic tradition, the name signifies one who maintains order, systematic, and organized. This quality is considered commendable in Islam, reflecting attributes of Allah. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the importance of organization and structure in personal and communal life.
